# vendor/ — pinned third-party assets (committed)

Generated by `npm run vendor` (tools/vendor-assets.js). Do not edit by hand.
build.js inlines these into the single-file artifact (fonts/icons as base64
data URIs, Chart.js as a plain <script>), replacing the former CDN tags —
the WebView loads no remote asset. (The app's only network traffic is the
native Play Billing, trial-anchor and cloud-backup plugins.)

| Asset | Source | Version |
|---|---|---|
| chart.umd.js | registry.npmjs.org chart.js tarball, dist/chart.umd.js | 4.4.1 |
| material-symbols-subset.woff2 + material-symbols.css | Google's material-design-icons codepoints file + fonts.googleapis.com css2 variable woff2, subset via subset-font to MS_ICON_NAMES | opsz24/wght300/FILL0/GRAD50 |
| fonts/*.woff2 + fonts.css | fonts.googleapis.com css2 API (latin variable) | Inter 400–700 / JetBrains Mono 500–700 / Space Grotesk 600–700 |

Font Awesome was removed (icon-unification step 5 — every icon call site
names a Material Symbols glyph directly now).

Regenerate after adding a NEW name to MS_ICON_NAMES in this script (build
output will show the missing glyph as a blank box until you do):
`npm run vendor && npm run build`. The script fails loudly if a name isn't
found in Google's codepoints map.
